## Create draft item for organization owned project

`POST /orgs/{org}/projectsV2/{project_number}/drafts`

Create draft issue item for the specified organization owned project.

### Parameters

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `org` | path | `string` | Yes | The organization name. The name is not case sensitive. |
| `project_number` | path | `integer` | Yes | The project's number. |

### Body Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `title` | `string` | Yes | The title of the draft issue item to create in the project. |
| `body` | `string` | No | The body content of the draft issue item to create in the project. |

### HTTP Response Status Codes

| Status Code | Description |
| :--- | :--- |
| `201` | Created |
| `304` | Not modified |
| `401` | Requires authentication |
| `403` | Forbidden |

## Create draft item for user owned project

`POST /user/{user_id}/projectsV2/{project_number}/drafts`

Create draft issue item for the specified user owned project.

### Parameters

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `user_id` | path | `string` | Yes | The unique identifier of the user. |
| `project_number` | path | `integer` | Yes | The project's number. |

### Body Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `title` | `string` | Yes | The title of the draft issue item to create in the project. |
| `body` | `string` | No | The body content of the draft issue item to create in the project. |

### HTTP Response Status Codes

| Status Code | Description |
| :--- | :--- |
| `201` | Created |
| `304` | Not modified |
| `401` | Requires authentication |
| `403` | Forbidden |
